'''Pyrospray''' or '''pyrotechnics''' was a [[Ta-Ree]] spell capable of being wielded by [[Ascendant (Kathol)|Ascendants]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kathol (planet)|Kathol]]. The spell allowed the caster to generate a spray of colorful lights and sparks which were accompanied by a staccato burst of noise.

Ascendants who wished to cast the spell were required to know the [[Light (Ta-Ree spell)|Light]] and [[psychokinesis]] spells.
